title: ffmpeg colour-matrix mismatch validator (601 vs 709)
purpose: Reusable script that numerically demonstrates the BT.601/BT.709 matrix mismatch described in the EncodingGuidelines documentation (art_01M6CQ0D711XXF9QTA7NVVMCJP rev 2). Encodes chromatic test patches through the 601 matrix and decodes through 709 (ffmpeg default behaviour with untagged stills), then compares to a correctly tagged 709→709 round-trip. Confirms the documented colour shift is measurable and that explicit colour-space tags eliminate it.
attribution: Academy Software Foundation EncodingGuidelines – colour preservation documentation, summarised in art_01M6CQ0D711XXF9QTA7NVVMCJP rev 2
